'x' varies directly with the cube of 'y', and inversely with the square of 'z'. If x = 
1_________36
 when y = 2 and z = 3, then what is the value of 800x when y = 3 and z = 5? 

'x', 'y' के घन के साथ सीधे बदलता है, और 'z' के वर्ग के साथ व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होता है। यदि x = 
1_________36
जब y = 2 और z = 3, तो 800x का मान क्या है जब y = 3 और z = 5?
questions.solution:
x = k X (y3)/(z2)

x = k X (y3)/(z2)

Substituting the given values:

1/36 = k X 23/32

1/36 = k X 8/9

k = 1/36 ÷ 8/9

k = 1/32

Now, find x when y = 3 and z = 5.

x = 1/32 X 33/52

x = 1/32 X 27/25

=> x = 27/800

800x = 800 X 27/800 = 27

questions.question: Arrange the jumbled sentence parts in the correct sequence. (P) hard work and perseverance (Q) no matter how difficult (O) lead to success (R) the journey may seem
questions.questionHtml:
Arrange the jumbled sentence parts in the correct sequence.

(P) hard work and perseverance

(Q) no matter how difficult

(O) lead to success

(R) the journey may seem
questions.solution:
"Hard work and perseverance" is an independent phrase and serves as the subject. "Lead to success" directly follows "hard work and perseverance", as it completes the thought by explaining the outcome. Together, "Hard work and perseverance lead to success" forms a meaningful phrase. Q sets up the idea that success happens despite challenges. "The journey may seem" completes the conditional phrase by specifying what is difficult.

The correct sentence is- "Hard work and perseverance lead to success, no matter how difficult the journey may seem."

questions.question: Arrange the sentences of a paragraph in the correct order. A. Summative assessment is the assignment of the student's performance at the end of the academic term. B. This new pattern ensures that besides just textbook teaching and learning, effective child-teacher interaction is encouraged. C. The CBSE envisages two types of examinations, Formative and Summative. D. Formative assessment is a part of the teaching-learning process and is done through conversation, quizzes, interviews, projects, assignments, etc.
questions.questionHtml:
Arrange the sentences of a paragraph in the correct order.

A. Summative assessment is the assignment of the student's performance at the end of the academic term.

B. This new pattern ensures that besides just textbook teaching and learning, effective child-teacher interaction is encouraged.

C. The CBSE envisages two types of examinations, Formative and Summative.

D. Formative assessment is a part of the teaching-learning process and is done through conversation, quizzes, interviews, projects, assignments, etc.
questions.solution:
· C (Introduction) mentions the two types of assessment.

· D (Formative assessment) describes one type.

· A (Summative assessment) describes the other type.

· B (Conclusion) explains the benefits of the system.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. The line, 'Round the rugged rocks the ragged rascal ran' uses the repetition of usually initial consonant sounds in two or more neighbouring words or syllables .
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The line, 'Round the rugged rocks the ragged rascal ran' uses the repetition of usually initial consonant sounds in two or more neighbouring words or syllables.
questions.solution:
· The sentence refers to the repetition of initial consonant sounds (e.g., "Round the rugged rocks...").

· Alliteration (correct choice) → A literary device where the same consonant sound is repeated at the beginning of closely connected words.

· Epithet → A descriptive phrase expressing a characteristic (e.g., "Alexander the Great").

· Simile → A comparison using "like" or "as" (e.g., "as brave as a lion").

· Allegory → A story with a hidden meaning, often moral or political.

questions.solution:
· Passive voice: "His father's arm was bandaged by the kind nurse."

· Active voice: "The kind nurse bandaged his father's arm."

· Option 1 ("has bandaged") is present perfect tense, incorrect.

· Option 2 ("had bandaged") is past perfect, incorrect.

· Option 3 ("bandages") is present simple, incorrect.

· Option 4 ("bandaged") is the correct simple past tense transformation.
